description: Machine-readable registry of synthetic QA user roles aligned with qa-agent/qa-user-roles.md.

roles.name: Owner and Platform Owner
roles.purpose: Tests owner-only visibility, system intelligence, SaaS readiness, global QA reports, and Owner AI boundaries.
blockedActionExamples: Acting outside explicit owner policy restrictions
Weakening tenant isolation for convenience
roles.dataVisibilityBoundary: Platform-level visibility according to owner permissions without exposing normal user Owner AI surfaces.
roles.personalAiBoundary: Must not be confused with normal Personal User AI; Owner AI scope and governance only.
roles.saasTenantBoundary: May assess cross-tenant readiness and policy; must not weaken tenant isolation.
roles.productionTestingPolicy: Prefer staging; production must be read-only unless explicitly approved by owner policy.

roles.name: Company Admin
roles.purpose: Tests company-level administration inside one tenant or company.
blockedActionExamples: Accessing another tenant's data or configuration
Using owner-only global platform controls without authorization
roles.dataVisibilityBoundary: Tenant-scoped administrative data for the administered company only.
roles.personalAiBoundary: Personal AI may assist only within the admin's tenant permissions and role limits.
roles.saasTenantBoundary: Strict single-tenant boundary; no cross-company reads or writes.
roles.productionTestingPolicy: Prefer staging; production synthetic admin users must be read-only unless explicitly approved.

roles.name: Finance Admin
roles.purpose: Tests finance workflows with create, edit, archive, delete, and restore permissions where allowed.
blockedActionExamples: Owner-only finance or platform actions
Cross-tenant finance reads or writes
roles.dataVisibilityBoundary: Tenant finance data permitted by finance admin role and record state.
roles.personalAiBoundary: AI may assist only with finance records and actions explicitly allowed to this user.
roles.saasTenantBoundary: No finance data or actions outside the active tenant boundary.
roles.productionTestingPolicy: Prefer staging; production must be read-only unless explicitly approved.

roles.name: Finance Viewer
roles.purpose: Tests read-only finance access and read-only AI assistance.
blockedActionExamples: Create, edit, archive, delete, restore, or approval execution in finance
Invoking write-capable tools or MCP actions for finance records
roles.dataVisibilityBoundary: Read-only finance records explicitly permitted to the viewer role.
roles.personalAiBoundary: AI cannot execute write actions; explain, navigate, and read-search only within permitted finance data.
roles.saasTenantBoundary: Read-only access within the active tenant only.
roles.productionTestingPolicy: Prefer staging; production must be read-only unless explicitly approved.

roles.name: HR Admin
roles.purpose: Tests HR module and people operations with HR administrative permissions.
blockedActionExamples: Unauthorized finance execution outside HR-approved scope
Cross-tenant HR access
roles.dataVisibilityBoundary: HR-sensitive records within authorized HR admin scope for the tenant.
roles.personalAiBoundary: AI must respect HR privacy, least privilege, and role boundaries for people data.
roles.productionTestingPolicy: Prefer staging; production must be read-only unless explicitly approved.

roles.name: HR Viewer and HR Assistant
roles.purpose: Tests limited HR support access with constrained AI.
blockedActionExamples: Accessing sensitive private employee data beyond permission
Editing restricted HR records without authorization
Payroll or HR approvals unless explicitly allowed to this role
roles.dataVisibilityBoundary: Minimum necessary HR data for the limited support role.
roles.personalAiBoundary: AI is restricted to role-limited HR data and non-destructive assistance unless explicitly allowed.
roles.productionTestingPolicy: Prefer staging; production must be read-only unless explicitly approved.

roles.name: Manager
blockedActionExamples: Owner-only or global platform settings
Unauthorized HR or finance admin operations outside manager scope
roles.dataVisibilityBoundary: Team and workflow data granted to the manager role within the tenant.
roles.personalAiBoundary: AI cannot exceed manager role permissions for people or finance visibility.
roles.productionTestingPolicy: Prefer staging; production must be read-only unless explicitly approved.

roles.name: Employee
roles.purpose: Tests normal employee self-service and strict least-privilege visibility.
blockedActionExamples: Must not see internal finance funding statuses
Must not see other employees' private data
Must not see admin-only HR data
Must not see company-wide sensitive records outside self-service scope
roles.dataVisibilityBoundary: Own records and explicitly shared records only within the tenant.
roles.personalAiBoundary: AI may help only with the employee's allowed records and actions; never exceed manual permissions.
roles.productionTestingPolicy: Prefer staging; production must be read-only unless explicitly approved.

roles.name: Guest and Restricted User
roles.purpose: Tests lowest-permission access; this role has the lowest practical permissions among standard synthetic personas.
blockedActionExamples: Sensitive route access
Write actions
Restricted tools or MCP actions
Private records outside explicitly allowed guest scope
roles.personalAiBoundary: No restricted tool or record access; explain and navigate only if policy allows even that.
roles.saasTenantBoundary: Strict tenant and role restrictions with default deny for unknown routes.
roles.productionTestingPolicy: Prefer staging; production must be read-only unless explicitly approved.

roles.name: SaaS Tenant Admin Future
roles.purpose: Tests SaaS tenant onboarding and company workspace setup when SaaS mode exists.
blockedActionExamples: Platform-owner-only controls
Configuration or reads for tenants other than the administered tenant
roles.dataVisibilityBoundary: Tenant admin scope for the administered tenant only.
roles.personalAiBoundary: Personal AI operates only within tenant-admin permissions and must not cross tenant boundaries.
roles.saasTenantBoundary: Must enforce strict tenant isolation, entitlements, and onboarding policy.
roles.productionTestingPolicy: Future role; verify only in dedicated staging or sandbox tenants; production must be read-only unless explicitly approved.
